identity.name: North American Spine Society Journal (NASSJ)
identity.source_note: Encoded from a headless render (Apify rag-web-browser) of the live ScienceDirect Guide for Authors; direct WebFetch returned HTTP 403. Note the correct ScienceDirect slug carries the -nassj suffix (the plain north-american-spine-society-journal path 404s).

encoding_notes: Peer review: guide explicitly states 'This journal follows a double anonymized review process' -> double_blind=true. The guide gives no explicit step-by-step de-identification instructions; separate_title_page/scrub flags are set true as entailed by the double-anonymized model plus the dedicated Title page section.

Article-type mapping: Clinical studies + Basic science studies + Spine surgery education studies all -> original_research; Clinical case reports/studies -> case_report + case_series; Systematic reviews/meta-analyses -> systematic_review; Editorials -> editorial; Letters to the editor / Replies -> letter.

Types with no clean enum slot (omitted): Commentaries (target 1,500 words, solicited on NASSJ content), Errata/Corrigenda, and 'critical reviews' mentioned in Aims & Scope (no dedicated article-type section with a structure/word cap).

Word limits: Clinical studies stated as 1500-4500 words (approx. 6-12 double-spaced pages); schema holds only the max (4500) -- the 1500 minimum has no slot. Basic science / spine education / case reports / systematic reviews have no explicit manuscript word cap in the guide. Commentaries 1,500 and Letters/Replies <500 words.

line_spacing left null: guide references '6 to 12 double-spaced pages' only as an approximation for word count, not as a prescribed formatting requirement; File format section mandates only single-column Word layout and removal of strikethrough/underline.
line_numbers null (unstated), page_numbers/running_head unstated -> conservative false/null. No running title is mentioned anywhere.

Abstract: primary instruction is a plain concise abstract <=250 words. A 'Structured abstract' section offers heading-based guidance but does not mandate structure or give fixed section labels, so structured=false / sections=null.
Keywords: 6-10 required, English, avoid multi-word keywords; no case or separator rule stated.
sections map left empty {}: guide says to 'divide into clearly defined sections using headings' but prescribes no ordered heading list (no explicit IMRAD ordering) for any type.

References style: numbered, square-bracket in-text [3,6], numbered in citation order; example format is Elsevier's numbered style with initials-before-surname authors, LTWA-abbreviated journal, (year) volume, pages, and DOI, and OMITS article titles -> encoded as 'custom' (not Vancouver/NLM/AMA, which include article titles).
journal_abbrev encoded as 'nlm' (nearest enum for 'abbreviated'); the guide actually specifies the ISSN List of Title Word Abbreviations (LTWA), not NLM/PubMed abbreviations.
include_doi=true: DOIs are encouraged as reference links and appear in every reference example.
et_al_threshold null: no 'et al.' rule stated; the software reference example lists ~17 authors in full.

Tables placement: guide permits either 'next to the relevant text' OR 'on a separate page(s) at the end' -> encoded in_text (first-listed); grouped_end is equally permitted. Caption position not specified (notes go below the table body).

Figures: separate files; formats EPS/PDF (vector) + TIFF/JPG/PNG (raster). min_dpi is TIERED and the schema holds one int: halftones/photos 300 dpi, bitmapped line drawings 1000 dpi, line/halftone combinations 500 dpi -> encoded the 300 dpi baseline. legends_location and callout_style left null (guide is silent on a fixed callout abbreviation; 'Fig. A.1' appears only for appendix figures, while file naming uses 'Figure_1').

Declarations: guide does not prescribe a strict ordered declarations block; 'order' is a reasonable sequence. Acknowledgements and the Generative-AI-use declaration are each stated to go directly before the reference list. Required set uses 'must' language (funding, competing interests) plus conditionally-required statements (ethics approval, patient consent, and trial registration when applicable to human/animal/trial studies). Data statement is 'encouraged' only -> not required.
A required 'Declaration of generative AI use' section (new section before references, when AI tools used) has no enum slot in declarations.

ORCID: not mentioned in the guide -> orcid_required=false. Cover letter: not required/mentioned -> false. Highlights: 'encouraged' (3-5 bullets, max 85 chars each, separate file) -> highlights_required=false.
Prospective clinical trials must be registered in an ICMJE-compliant public registry before submission; registration number preferably at end of the abstract.
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
[schema-required default] layout.line_numbers defaulted to 'none' (guide silent).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
